161    public static Map<Integer, Class<? extends HistoryLog>> LOG_MESSAGE_IDS = new HashMap<>();
162    public static Map<Class<? extends HistoryLog>, Integer> LOG_MESSAGE_CLASS_TO_ID = new HashMap<>();
163
164    static {
165        for (Class<? extends HistoryLog> clazz : LOG_MESSAGE_TYPES) {
166            try {
167                LOG_MESSAGE_IDS.put(clazz.newInstance().typeId(), clazz);
168                LOG_MESSAGE_CLASS_TO_ID.put(clazz, clazz.newInstance().typeId());
169            } catch (IllegalAccessException|InstantiationException e) {
170                L.e(TAG, String.format("could not instantiate %s", clazz), e);
171                e.printStackTrace();
172            }
173        }
174    }
175
176    /**
177     * Reads the typeId from the first two bytes of a raw history log.
178     *
179     * <p>Those bytes are a little-endian uint16 whose low 12 bits are the typeId. The top 4 bits
180     * are not part of the id and their meaning is unknown, see
181     * {@link HistoryLog#getHeaderHighNibble()}. This applies the same mask
182     * {@link HistoryLog#parseBase} already used, and matches Tandem's own Mobi Android app, which
183     * reads these two bytes little endian and masks with 4095 before resolving the log type.
184     *
185     * <p>Without the mask, a record carrying a nonzero high nibble produces an inflated typeId
186     * (opCode 55 with a nibble of 1 reads as 4151), misses {@link #LOG_MESSAGE_IDS}, and is only
187     * recovered by the retry ladder in {@link #parse}, which logs a warning for every such record.
188     * The masking also corrects dispatch for typeIds of 128-255, which the previous signed-byte
189     * arithmetic resolved to typeId+256.
190     */
191    public static int typeIdOf(byte[] rawStream) {
192        return Bytes.readShort(rawStream, 0) & 4095;
193    }
194
195    public static HistoryLog parse(byte[] rawStream) {
196        int typeId = typeIdOf(rawStream);
197        HistoryLog ret = parseWithTypeId(rawStream, typeId);
198        if (ret instanceof UnknownHistoryLog) {
199            L.w(TAG, "retry1 HistoryLog parse on typeId " + typeId + " => " + ((byte) typeId));
200            HistoryLog two = parseWithTypeId(rawStream, (byte) typeId);
201            if (!(two instanceof UnknownHistoryLog)) {
202                return two;
203            }
204            if ((byte) typeId < 0) {
205                L.w(TAG, "retry2 HistoryLog parse on typeId " + ((byte) typeId) + " => " + (((byte) typeId) + 512));
206                HistoryLog three = parseWithTypeId(rawStream, (((byte) typeId) + 512));
207                if (!(three instanceof UnknownHistoryLog)) {
208                    return three;
209                }
210            }
211        }
212        return ret;
213    }
214
215    private static HistoryLog parseWithTypeId(byte[] rawStream, int typeId) {
216        HistoryLog historyLog = null;
217        if (!LOG_MESSAGE_IDS.containsKey(typeId)) {
218            L.t(TAG, "unknown HistoryLog typeId "+typeId+": "+ Hex.encodeHexString(rawStream));
219            historyLog = new UnknownHistoryLog();
220            historyLog.parse(rawStream);
221            L.i(TAG, String.format("PARSED-EMBEDDED-HISTORY-LOG(typeId=%-3d, UNKNOWN): %s", typeId, Hex.encodeHexString(rawStream)));
222            return historyLog;
223        }
224
225        try {
226            historyLog = LOG_MESSAGE_IDS.get(typeId).newInstance();
227        } catch (IllegalAccessException|InstantiationException e) {
228            L.e(TAG, "could not instantiate "+typeId, e);
229            e.printStackTrace();
230            return null;
231        }
232
233        String name = MessageHelpers.lastTwoParts(historyLog.getClass().getName());
234        L.t(TAG, "found matching "+name+" HistoryLog typeId "+typeId+": "+ Hex.encodeHexString(rawStream));
235        historyLog.parse(rawStream);
236        L.i(TAG, String.format("PARSED-EMBEDDED-HISTORY-LOG(typeId=%-3d, %s): %s", typeId, name, historyLog.toString()));
237        return historyLog;
238    }
